external.label: committed 27 Nov 2026, in 4d75c86
external.note: 164 HumanEval tasks (MIT), judged by EvalPlus HumanEval+ tests (Apache-2.0) as an outside oracle. Figures are taken from bench/external/results.json (aethens 0.1.0.dev0, seed 0, budget standard, exhaustive mutation on with the C004 equivalent-mutant filter), committed in 4d75c86 on 27 Nov 2026. The full 164-task run is not regenerated by GitHub CI (make check runs a six-task sample only). Hosted CI run 45969249199 is the main-branch check of that commit. C004 precision 0.8158 (31 of 38 surviving mutants rejected by HumanEval+), recall 0.80 (24 of 30 weak tasks). Without the equivalent-mutant filter (same run): precision 0.4615, recall 0.8667. C003 was not run (HumanEval has no labelled candidates). C007 was not run (the verifier is Aethens' own unittest conversion, so probe results would describe the converter, not HumanEval). 20 tasks whose original canonical solution fails the HumanEval+ oracle are excluded from C004 precision and recall.
